> Add **concise** overview of what this PR aims to achieve or accomplish. Reference related GitHub issues and PRs that help with the review.

The dapo multi model optimization practice is now available for verl 0.7.1.

### Checklist Before Starting

- [ ] Search for similar PRs. Paste at least one query link here: ...
- [ ] Format the PR title as `[{modules}] {type}: {description}` (This will be checked by the CI)
  - `{modules}` include `fsdp`, `megatron`, `veomni`, `sglang`, `vllm`, `vllm_omni`, `rollout`, `trainer`, `ci`, `training_utils`, `recipe`, `hardware`, `deployment`, `ray`, `worker`, `single_controller`, `misc`, `perf`, `model`, `algo`, `env`, `tool`, `ckpt`, `doc`, `data`, `cfg`, `reward`, `fully_async`, `one_step_off`
  - If this PR involves multiple modules, separate them with `,` like `[megatron, fsdp, doc]`
  - `{type}` is in `feat`, `fix`, `refactor`, `chore`, `test`
  - If this PR breaks any API (CLI arguments, config, function signature, etc.), add `[BREAKING]` to the beginning of the title.
  - Example: `[BREAKING][fsdp, megatron] feat: dynamic batching`

### Test

> For changes that can not be tested by CI (e.g., algorithm implementation, new model support), validate by experiment(s) and show results like training curve plots, evaluation results, etc.

### API and Usage Example

> Demonstrate how the API changes if any, and provide usage example(s) if possible.

```python
# Add code snippet or script demonstrating how to use this
```

### Design & Code Changes

> Demonstrate the high-level design if this PR is complex, and list the specific changes.

### Checklist Before Submitting

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Please check all the following items before requesting a review, otherwise the reviewer might deprioritize this PR for review.

- [ ] Read the [Contribute Guide](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).

- [ ] Add / Update [the documentation](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/tree/main/docs).

- [ ] Once your PR is ready for CI, send a message in [the `ci-request` channel](https://verl-project.slack.com/archives/C091TCESWB1) in [the `verl` Slack workspace](https://join.slack.com/t/verl-project/shared_invite/zt-3855yhg8g-CTkqXu~hKojPCmo7k_yXTQ). - [ ] If your PR is related to the `recipe` submodule, please also update the reference to the submodule commit via `git submodule update --remote` or `cd recipe && git pull origin main`.

## Code Review

This pull request updates the hardware and software requirements for the DAPO multi-model optimization tutorial, including version bumps for CANN, torch, and vllm, and the addition of performance-related environment variables. It also fixes a malformed URL in the documentation. A review comment points out an inconsistency where a branch name is used for the verl repository checkout instead of a specific commit ID, which is necessary to ensure reproducibility as described in the tutorial text.

![high](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/high-priority.svg)

The command uses a branch name (`release/v0.7.1`), which contradicts the instruction in line 78 that states a specific commit ID should be used to avoid introducing issues. To ensure reproducibility and consistency with the environment table (line 73), use the specific commit ID.

```suggestion
git checkout 02e059ea18f5adf9768c5d9c280456cdfdfeda01
```

@@ -206,6 +206,8 @@ export LD_PRELOAD=/usr/local/lib/libjemalloc.so.2

 NNODES 和 NPUS_PER_NODE: 修改为使用节点数量和每个节点 NPU 数量。在此案例中分别为2和8。
